scenario_text:
We're deploying the backend for a customer-facing booking API. Expect around
25 concurrent users at peak, mostly short read-write transactions. The database
will hold roughly 10 GB. The host has 4 GB RAM and 2 vCPU. This is real
production traffic so it needs to be secured properly, but we're not under any
specific regulatory regime.
